say:2:1320206001:0.text: Phew! You guys were just like in those adventure stories—you arrived just in time to save my skin!
say:2:1320206001:0.source_cn: 哈！你们就像故事里讲的那样！在俺吓破胆的时候登场了！

choice_prompt:3:1320206001.text: Phew! You guys were just like in those adventure stories—you arrived just in time to save my skin!
choice_prompt:3:1320206001.source_cn: 哈！你们就像故事里讲的那样！在俺吓破胆的时候登场了！

say:4:1320206004:1.text: You can call me Kliff, I'm a hunter—although I was just about to be someone else's prey...
say:4:1320206004:1.source_cn: 俺叫克利夫，是一名猎人，虽然刚才差点就成猎物了……

say:5:1320206005:1.text: You've been hunting in the Duskmire Forest?
say:5:1320206005:1.source_cn: 你一直在黑森林沼泽狩猎吗？

say:6:1320206006:1.text: No one sane would ever hunt here! It was a total accident...
say:6:1320206006:1.source_cn: 怎么可能！俺是误入这里的……

say:7:1320206007:1.text: I had my eyes on this pretty little mink, which would have been an easy kill, but I wanted to catch it alive so its fur would still be intact!
say:7:1320206007:1.source_cn: 起初俺是盯上一只漂亮的鼬鼠，如果要杀掉它很容易，但是活...

say:8:1320206008:1.text: I was super caught up chasing this mink.
say:8:1320206008:1.source_cn: 谁知道那小畜生“滑溜”得很，俺不知道追了它多久。

say:9:1320206009:1.text: Before I realized it, I'd already wandered into this forest. How careless of me!
say:9:1320206009:1.source_cn: 回过神来时人已经在黑森林了，真是大意！

say:10:1320206010:0.text: I tried to leave at first, but it seemed like there was no way out of this damned place. No matter which direction I walked, it was like I was going in circles!
say:10:1320206010:0.source_cn: 俺的第一反应是赶紧离开，但这鬼地方就像没有出口一样，无...

say:11:1320206011:0.text: You guys seem really knowledgeable. Any idea what's going on?
say:11:1320206011:0.source_cn: 你们看起来见多识广，能看看这是咋回事吗？

choice_prompt:12:1320206011.text: You guys seem really knowledgeable. Any idea what's going on?
choice_prompt:12:1320206011.source_cn: 你们看起来见多识广，能看看这是咋回事吗？

say:14:1320206013:1.text: It's a type of creature that makes people lose their way in this forest. But don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> here already got rid of all of them! Nobody should get lost again.
say:14:1320206013:1.source_cn: 会让人迷失在黑森林中的怪物，已经被<style=str...
say:14:1320206013:1.male: It's a type of creature that makes people lose their way in this forest. But don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> here already got rid of all of them! Nobody should get lost again.
say:14:1320206013:1.female: It's a type of creature that makes people lose their way in this forest. But don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> here already got rid of all of them! Nobody should get lost again.

say:15:1320206014:1.text: Hah! Looks like I need to thank you guys twice! I have to thank my wife for that amulet, too!
say:15:1320206014:1.source_cn: 哈！看样子俺要感谢你们两次了！噢不对，是三次！还要感谢...

say:17:1320206015:1.text: I only wore it because she nagged me to death. Maybe this amulet is why I got so lucky!
say:17:1320206015:1.source_cn: 如果不是她唠唠叨叨，俺才懒得戴，没准是这小东西让俺这么...

say:18:1320206016:1.text: Actually, I'm out hunting because I want to finish making my wife a new minkskin dress before the ceremony.
say:18:1320206016:1.source_cn: 不怕你们笑话，俺想在祭典前给老婆做件新衣服，拖了不知道...

say:19:1320206017:1.text: I've got to finish skinning this mink. Oh! As thanks for saving me, why don't you guys come rest at my village? Just head north and you'll find it.
say:19:1320206017:1.source_cn: 回去前俺得把鼬鼠的皮毛处理一下，对了，俺的村子就在沼泽...

say:20:1320206018:1.text: Speaking of which, if you happen to see my wife, can you tell her I'm alright? I've been gone for days, so I'm sure she's worried.
say:20:1320206018:1.source_cn: 对了，如果你见到俺那位，能转达下平安吗？俺也出来好几天...
say:20:1320206018:1.male: Speaking of which, if you happen to see my wife, can you tell her I'm alright? I've been gone for days, so I'm sure she's worried.
say:20:1320206018:1.female: Speaking of which, if you happen to see my wife, can you tell her I'm alright? I've been gone for days, so I'm sure she's worried.

say:21:1320206019:1.text: I gotta finish her dress as quickly as I can. I can't wait to see the surprise on her face!
say:21:1320206019:1.source_cn: 俺也有点等不及了呢，真想早点把她衣服做好了，看到她惊喜...

choice:12:0:1.text: It must've been a hawk moth.
choice:12:0:1.male: It must've been a hawk moth.
choice:12:0:1.female: It must've been a hawk moth.

say:23:1320206002:1.text: Prayers? Ahh... Right, I was praying silently!
say:23:1320206002:1.source_cn: 祈祷？啊……是的，俺算是在心里祈祷了吧！

say:24:1320206003:1.text: So this is what heroes look like? I guess it's pretty much what I imagined!
say:24:1320206003:1.source_cn: 原来英雄长这个样子！跟想象中也差不多嘛！
